prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 6 tests (up to +15.4%), though 2 hurt performance (down to -7.7%) and 5 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 4 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 10 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) and redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 2 tests each (up to +8.7% and +9.0%), though several hurt performance and most showed no clear effect.
Copy updates (copy) were helpful in 1 test (+5.7%), but showed no clear effect in 7 tests.
Step reordering (reorder), hints, notifications, and new flows produced no winning tests; step reordering hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and no clear effect was seen in the rest.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two-Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a two-column layout separating companion statistics from official adoption confirmation. (why: The adoption stage shows a long mean duration (1017s); a balanced two-column layout makes companion details clearer and speeds up adoption confirmation.)
1: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Companion Activity Animation Stream: Add an animated activity stream component on the waiting screen showing real-time pet setup actions while desktop rendering completes. (why: Waiting step mean time is high (2336s); entertaining animation updates reduce perceived wait time and prevent users from abandoning while waiting for desktop load.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Recovery Instructions on Sign-In Screen: Update the sign-in screen copy to explicitly state that logging in restores existing pets and prevents loss of companion data. (why: Support received 8 complaints about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Mascot Greeting Component: Add a mascot component to the Choose Path screen giving guidance on preset versus custom creation paths. (why: 19.1% drop off at choose_path; adding direct visual guidance clarifies options for hesitant users.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Screen Grid Layout Redesign: Redesign pick_friend screen using a balanced grid layout for companion cards. (why: Structuring adoption choices into a grid comparison layout helps users compare companion visuals faster and complete adoption smoother.)
